# Winter Car Prep

> Winter Car Prep (wintercarprep.com) is a free winter-driving guide site.
> Simple, honest guides to winter tires, batteries, emergency kits and rust
> protection — written to get a car winter-ready before the first snowfall.
> Launched November 2026. Canadian winter focus.

- Main site: https://wintercarprep.com/
- About: https://wintercarprep.com/about.html
- Contact: https://wintercarprep.com/contact.html
- Privacy policy: https://wintercarprep.com/privacy-policy.html
- Sitemap: https://wintercarprep.com/sitemap.xml
- RSS feed: https://wintercarprep.com/feed.xml
